title: On my book tour … jokes (part 1)
excerpt: People keep bringing me new riffs on the old “chicken crossing road” joke. Here’s one: Q: What is the chicken’s deepest unfulfilled desire? (answer below the jump) A: – To cross the road WITHOUT ANYONE QUESTIONING HIS MOTIVES!
body:
People keep bringing me new riffs on the old “chicken crossing road” joke. Here’s one:

 Q: What is the chicken’s deepest unfulfilled desire?

 (answer below the jump)

A: – To cross the road WITHOUT ANYONE QUESTIONING HIS MOTIVES!
